mapper.select:
select id, account, name, auth_status, disabled from ( SELECT id, account, name, auth_status, disabled FROM shop_info si WHERE si.is_deleted=FALSE
and ((si.account = #{params.searchKeyword}) or (si.id = #{params.searchKeyword}) or si.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
and si.dict_area_code = #{params.dictAreaCode}
and si.dict_platform = #{params.dictPlatform}
and si.id in
(#{item})
order by
case when si.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when si.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when si.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , si.name,
si.disabled asc ) shop
